RUN.about: Cut by the life of a chat session — a user signs in, lands in the chat interface that submits messages through the AI pipeline (which may create artifacts), with sidebar history always accessible.

issues.title: No unique constraint on user email
issues.detail: The User table has no unique index on email. The register action checks for duplicates before inserting, but concurrent registrations could create two users with the same email. Login then picks the first row arbitrarily.

issues.title: isAnonymous column never set for guests
issues.detail: The User schema has an isAnonymous boolean defaulting to false, but createGuestUser never sets it to true. Guest detection relies entirely on the email matching the pattern guest-\d+.

issues.title: Check-then-insert race on registration

rows.title: Look up user

rows.title: No user found
rows.detail: Runs compare(password, DUMMY_PASSWORD) to burn the same time as a real check, then returns null.

rows.title: User has no password
rows.detail: Same dummy compare and null return to prevent distinguishing no-user from no-password.

rows.title: Compare password
rows.detail: Runs compare(password, user.password) via bcrypt-ts. Returns null on mismatch.

issues.title: Guest and regular users have identical limits
issues.detail: Both user types are capped at 10 messages per hour. The entitlement structure supports differentiation, but both values are currently 10.
